factor: single factor: scheduler-side prefill admission throttle. New env SGLANG_PREFILL_BUDGET_UNDER_DECODE (default -1 = exactly current behavior, opt-in). While any decode request is runnable (non-empty filtered running_batch), each scheduling round's prefill chunk budget (chunked_prefill_size, incl. dynamic-chunk-sizer output, feeding PrefillAdder rem_chunk_tokens) is capped at the budget; queued prefills beyond the cap wait for later rounds in unchanged FCFS order; with zero runnable decode the full chunk budget is used. Site: python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py:4206-4246 inside _get_new_batch_prefill_raw (cap applied before get_prefill_adder_class() construction); helpers scheduler.py:405-459; single startup env read in init_chunked_prefill at scheduler.py:1430 (called once from Scheduler.__init__), strict int parse, ValueError on garbage incl. 0 and < -1. One INFO log per clipped scheduling decision (budget, requested, admitted, decode_runnable; gated on queued demand exceeding the cap so unclipped rounds stay unlogged). No kernel/.so changes; no attention/backend file touched; retract/abort paths untouched (cap only shrinks the rem_chunk_tokens scalar the adder already consumes; adder's existing extend_len<=0 OTHER path prevents zero-progress rounds for pathological tiny budgets)
factor_hypothesis: C32 stalls come from 8192-token eager prefill forwards interposed between decode steps; capping admitted new prefill tokens per forward while decode runs bounds each inter-position gap at roughly (budget/8192) of today's prefill forward time, compressing the per-user max inter-token gap distribution toward the budget/chunk throughput point (target: 120/160 requests >0.5s and 1.38s median max-gap drop sharply; min tok/s stays >30) at the cost of spreading prefill over more, smaller forwards: TTFT increases modestly (same total prefill FLOPs, slightly worse prefill efficiency per token) and p50 tok/s may dip if smaller extend forwards are less efficient; unlike chunked-prefill-size 2048 (which made things worse by making every prefill eager-small and slowing drain) this only shrinks forwards when decode is actively waiting and keeps 8192 chunks when the server is prefill-only; expected throughput/TTFT/gap numbers UNKNOWN until Controller's model run
